# Reservas Kalawala — Vacation Rentals in Puerto Viejo, Costa Rica

> Kalawala is a family-run vacation rental company offering fully equipped houses and villas in Puerto Viejo de Talamanca, Limón, Costa Rica. We manage 10 properties sleeping 2–8 guests, all with private kitchens, bathrooms, A/C, and free WiFi. Book directly on our website for the best rates — cheaper than Airbnb or Booking.com. Bilingual site (English and Spanish).

- [Casa Rana](https://www.reservaskalawala.com/Rana): 2-bedroom house, sleeps 5, private fenced parking, pet friendly, fenced garden — ideal for traveling with pets. Fully equipped kitchen, 2 A/C units, 100Mbps WiFi.

## Location & Area

Puerto Viejo de Talamanca is on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast in Limón province. The town is surrounded by tropical rainforest and borders two National Parks: Manzanillo Wildlife Refuge and Cahuita National Park. Known for stunning beaches (Playa Cocles, Playa Chiquita, Punta Uva), surfing, wildlife, and vibrant nightlife.

Getting around: bike or scooter rental recommended. Public bus service connects to Cahuita, Manzanillo, and Sixaola. Properties with parking noted above.
